reviews.title: 6 string or bust.
reviews.text:
Kind of a jumbled mess. My friend and I have both experienced the app and it is great for them as a 6 string guitar player as a bass player I have learned more from YouTube and a $5 book at my local music store.

They talk a big game about having the rights to so many songs. Yeah but you don’t have the lyrics you have extremely stripped down versions of songs. Again a quick google search and I can find tabs better than what they are selling with the option to edit the backing to my choice and at the speed I can comfortable play at until I master it.

This app crashes like it gets paid for each time you have to close and open it. Don’t even think about switching your screen to say check a text or even look up what they are talking about in a lesson your play-along with because it will simply stop working.

Here is an idea Fender how about for your play alongs with the instructor you actually have the tabs scroll as you play that way you can actively in real time see your mistakes and correct them by rewinding the video instead of jumping between two separate videos hoping the app doesn’t crash?

Also why as an electric instrument player are you teaching me how to turn on my amp on after 20+ lessons of playing? I don’t mean edit your treble, mid, and bass to create new interesting sounds I mean how to flip on the power switch. Kind of sounds a bit disjointed doesn’t it?

The over all lesson structure feels like it was made by a hung over college music intern slapping together videos with Ai support after being out partying all night and this was their final project before they switch majors.

Bottom line is that if you are a 6-string player you will have a great time and made to feel supported, anything else you are going to feel like the rejected middle child from an app you are paying for. You are better off spending your money on a different app instead of something this sloppy.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text:
I’m trying this app to learn guitar. It has some nice features and provides a learning path with lessons, practice and feedback. The problem is the app is just very glitchy. It has crashed on my eve. Using the feedback feature. I’m unable to change the learning path level beyond level 1. I’ve tried the app on both my iPhone and iPad, these problems persist on both devices. If it was a stable and reliable app, I would continue using it. But it’s not worth paying the subscription with these impediments.

For those looking for specific songs, the songs available are limited. I see a lot from Metallica. But then there are zero songs from other artists: U2, Johnny Cash.

reviews.title: Not for Beginners
reviews.text: I spent a few weeks trying to learn guitar from scratch with this app and was frustrated every step of the way. Why? It’s not for beginners! Despite being advertised as such, every single video lesson along my “path” starts with “have you ever been doing this on guitar…?” No! Obviously I haven’t because I have never picked one up in my life! I don’t care that the lessons are free since I purchased their product, the developers should pay me to use this app. Don’t get me wrong, there is good information within if you know what you’re doing, but if you don’t, don’t waste your time.

reviews.title: Fender Play is incredible
reviews.text:
Fender Play is a great option for learning electric guitar. There are songs, chords, and, unlike Simply Guitar, it actually teaches you tablature. There is one bug, however, and that’s sometimes when I play a video for a course, it glitches and plays the audio from the start while continuing to play the audio from where I’m at, and the video is just frozen. I just restart the app when that happens, but if you could fix it that would be great. Anyway, I just wanted to say I found an easier way to play Enter Sandman, the third riff on the course I’m currently doing. You play open low E 3 times, then you play the 6th fret on low E, then the 5th fret, then repeat, but on each repeat play the first low E 4 times. That’s how I found it easier to play.
Can you see why I call myself the Overranter? Sorry for making you read, whoever sees this.
